## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo xtask ci` passes locally
- [ ] Title follows Conventional Commits (`feat(parser): …`)
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO)
- [ ] Tests added or updated; no test weakened or deleted
- [ ] No new dependencies, or each is justified in `docs/dependencies.md`
- [ ] Docs, spec or ADRs updated if behavior or decisions changed
- [ ] `docs/STATUS.md` / `CHANGELOG.md` updated if user-visible
